A course evaluation in which students rate each part of a course on 1 grid, compared between students who took it in person and online. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the analysis plan and a report for the teaching team.

## Preview the questionnaire

This is the questionnaire as respondents see it. It is a preview to try, and it stores no answers. [Open the Course evaluation survey preview in a new tab](../../templates/matrix_likert/preview.html){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

```{=html}
<iframe src="../../templates/matrix_likert/preview.html" title="Preview of the Course evaluation survey questionnaire" style="width:100%;height:560px;border:1px solid #d9e2ec;border-radius:6px"></iframe>
```

## The example analysis plan

Before any data is collected, surveyframe writes the pre-analysis plan: the study, the questionnaire, each research question with its hypotheses, method and decision rule, and the fields a preregistration still asks you to complete. [Read the Course evaluation survey plan](../../templates/matrix_likert/plan.html), or [download the Course evaluation survey instrument (.sframe)](../../templates/matrix_likert/matrix_likert.sframe) to adapt it.

Methods it declares: Descriptive statistics, Frequencies and percentages, Cross-tabulation.

## Open this instrument in SurveyStudio

1. Set up R, RStudio and surveyframe as [Get started](../start.html) shows.
2. To explore the example with its demonstration responses, open RStudio's **Addins** menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `matrix_likert`, which opens this template's study.
3. To make it your own study, download the instrument above, choose **surveyframe: Open analysis workspace** from the **Addins** menu, then **Open Instrument** in SurveyStudio's left menu, and select the file.
4. Adapt the questions on the **Design** screen and the research questions under **Plan**, press **Save to Studio**, then press **Download copy** on the **Report** screen to save your study.

## Questions

### Can I change the parts of the course?

Yes. Edit the rows of the grid in SurveyStudio's Design screen. Each row becomes its own column in the data.

### Can students answer anonymously?

This example omits a name field and generates a response id. Review the remaining questions and your collection settings when you design the study's privacy arrangements.

### How do I collect the answers?

Download the survey as 1 HTML file from the Collect screen and share it, with a free Google Sheet collecting the answers.
